_note: 步骤③「待桥接到 Base 销毁的 IMD」的文案。等子代理完成步骤②后合并进 locales/*.json。

zh.awaiting.title: 待桥接到 Base 销毁的 IMD
zh.awaiting.currentSub: 躺在中转合约里，还没被销毁
zh.awaiting.what: 这 {amount} IMD 是待桥接销毁，不是已销毁。中转合约（BurnExecutor）自己不会烧币——它只是把抽走的 IMD 收在一起，等有人付手续费把它桥到 Base 链，那边才会真正销毁。
zh.awaiting.movingExplain: 余额有涨有跌，说明有人在推动这道门。
zh.awaiting.growingExplain: 余额只涨不跌，说明第二道门目前没有人在推——IMD 在合约里排队，没有被送走。
zh.awaiting.flatExplain: 余额没有变化，既没有新的 IMD 送进来，也没有被送走。
zh.awaiting.devQuote: 项目方在区块 25793366 说过：“updated the burnExecutor contract so anyone can call it, would be nice if someone creates a bot for it”——所以「没人在推」这件事是有原文出处的。
zh.awaiting.noteUnavailable: 中转合约的余额读不到，无法判断第二道门的状态。这不是 0，是未知。
zh.awaiting.snapshotAt: 历史点来自 {p0} 生成的快照（由链上 Transfer 日志重建），当前值每 60 秒从链上直读。

en.awaiting.title: IMD awaiting bridge to Base for burning
en.awaiting.currentSub: sitting in the waypoint contract, not yet destroyed
en.awaiting.what: These {amount} IMD are awaiting a bridge for burning — they are not burned yet. The waypoint contract (BurnExecutor) does not burn anything: it collects the IMD pulled out by trims and holds it until someone pays gas to bridge it to Base, where the actual destruction happens.
en.awaiting.movingExplain: The balance has both risen and fallen, so someone is pushing this door.
en.awaiting.growingExplain: The balance has only risen, so nobody is pushing this door right now — IMD is queueing up in the contract instead of being sent on.
en.awaiting.flatExplain: The balance has not moved: nothing new arrived and nothing left.
en.awaiting.devQuote: The dev said at block 25793366: “updated the burnExecutor contract so anyone can call it, would be nice if someone creates a bot for it” — so “nobody is pushing” is a statement with a source.
en.awaiting.noteUnavailable: The waypoint contract's balance could not be read, so the second door's state is unknown. That is not zero.
en.awaiting.snapshotAt: The historical points come from a snapshot generated at {p0}, rebuilt from on-chain Transfer logs; the current value is read straight from the chain every 60 seconds.
